title: MRAM At The SNIA SDC And 10 Years Since The Everspin IPO
summary: Forbes explores Everspin Technologies' CXL-attached MRAM demonstration at SNIA SDC 2026, persistent memory for AI data centers and 10 years since its IPO.
body_markdown:
In Forbes, technology analyst Thomas Coughlin highlights Everspin Technologies’ demonstration of CXL-connected MRAM at the 2026 SNIA Storage Developers Conference, exploring how persistent memory can improve data center performance and AI infrastructure efficiency. The article also examines Everspin’s growth, MRAM technology advancements and expanding market applications as the company celebrates 10 years since its Nasdaq IPO.


[Read the full Forbes article](https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomcoughlin/2026/10/05/mram-at-the-snia-sdc-and-10-years-since-the-everspin-ipo/)
